hypothesis: If identity-plane destructive tradecraft is attempted then privileged role activation or bulk device actions will appear in audit logs
required_fields: TimeGenerated; OperationName; InitiatedBy; TargetResources; Result; IPAddress; UserAgent
required_telemetry: Entra ID AuditLogs and Intune audit logs
expected_malicious_pattern: Bulk wipe/retire/delete actions or risky privileged activation by recently changed privileged identity
expected_benign_pattern: Approved lifecycle action from device admin group with change ticket
exclusion_logic: Exclude known device lifecycle automation accounts and approved maintenance windows
stop_condition: No destructive device actions or all actions mapped to approved change records
escalation_threshold: Any wipe/retire/delete action by unapproved privileged identity; more than 5 actions in 10m

hypothesis: If MuddyWater-style RMM abuse is active then unauthorized RMM execution will appear from user-controlled paths
required_fields: Timestamp; DeviceName; FileName; FolderPath; ProcessCommandLine; InitiatingProcessFileName; RemoteUrl; RemoteIP
required_telemetry: EDR process events and approved RMM inventory
expected_malicious_pattern: RMM installer or binary executing from Downloads Temp AppData or browser/mail parent process
expected_benign_pattern: Approved IT deployment path, signed vendor updater, known management subnet
exclusion_logic: Exclude approved RMM tools, deployment shares, IT admin groups, and software distribution paths
stop_condition: No unapproved RMM execution or all hits tied to approved IT change
escalation_threshold: Any unapproved RMM execution from user-controlled path with external C2 connection

hypothesis: If exposed PLC/HMI surfaces are targeted then OT management paths or ports will show external access
required_tables: Firewall; proxy; OT NDR; VPN; web logs
required_fields: Time; SourceIP; DestinationIP; DestinationPort; URL; UserAgent; Action; AssetOwner
expected_malicious_pattern: External access to PLC/HMI paths or OT ports from unapproved source infrastructure
expected_benign_pattern: Approved vendor remote session through VPN/jump host
exclusion_logic: Exclude approved VPN concentrators, jump hosts, and vendor maintenance windows
stop_condition: All internet-exposed PLC/HMI services removed or documented with compensating controls
escalation_threshold: Any direct public access to PLC/HMI management or OT ports

hypothesis: If VIP phishing is active then mail click events will correlate to risky sign-in or execution
required_fields: Recipient; SenderFromAddress; Url; TimeGenerated; AccountUpn; RiskLevel; FileName; ProcessCommandLine
required_telemetry: Email URL click IdP and EDR logs
expected_malicious_pattern: Mail click followed by executable/script launch or risky login from new infrastructure
expected_benign_pattern: User clicked known business SaaS link with normal sign-in and no endpoint execution
exclusion_logic: Exclude sanctioned SaaS campaigns, phishing simulations, and known partner portals
stop_condition: No risky sign-in or endpoint execution after click
escalation_threshold: VIP click followed by new-country sign-in, AitM indicators, or process execution
